newsitem.title: USA: NAL Financial stake cut by Bay Pond.
newsitem.headline: NAL Financial stake cut by Bay Pond.

text.p: A group including Bay Pond Partners L.P. on Monday said it cut its stake in NAL Financial Group Inc. to 420,000 common shares, or 4.27 percent of the total outstanding, from 522,400 shares, or 5.65 percent.
In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it sold 102,400 shares of NAL Financial on Monday at $8.875 each.
With its stake reduced to less than 5 percent, the group is no longer required to report dealings with the company or its stock to the SEC.
